notes_for_editor: Status 'gone' rests on one hobbyist page (argenweb) that gives no removal date. The 1956 NGS datasheet is the only dated primary-style record of the tower. Search snippets mentioned an elevation of about 1,818 ft and a summit trail (PeakVisor); neither was read, so neither is used. The argenweb 'old concrete footers' sentence refers to Vanderslice Mountain, not Muddy. No build date, builder, staffing or access source was found, so those keys are omitted. Suggested next step: Mena/Oden Ranger District records, 1603 Hwy 71 North, Mena, AR.
